error.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
error.ITEM_NOT_FOUND: That item couldn't be found — it may have been deleted.
error.ITEM_NOT_COMPLETABLE: Notes and tips can't be completed.
error.ITEM_ARCHIVED: This item is archived. Unarchive it first.
error.ITEM_FIELD_NOT_APPLICABLE: This field doesn't apply to this type of item.
error.DATA_INCONSISTENT: Local data is inconsistent. Please export diagnostics and contact the developers.
error.STORAGE_CONSTRAINT: Couldn't save: the data conflicts with existing content.
error.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: The local database is temporarily unavailable.
error.STORAGE_CORRUPT: Local data is damaged. Please export diagnostics.
error.WINDOW_UNAVAILABLE: Couldn't open the window. Please check the diagnostics.
error.SHORTCUT_INVALID: That isn't a usable shortcut: it needs at least one modifier key (Ctrl / Alt / Shift / Win) plus a key.
error.SHORTCUT_CONFLICT: That shortcut is used by another app. Try a different one.
error.SOURCE_FILE_MISSING: The file is no longer where it was — it may have been moved or deleted.
error.CLIPBOARD_UNAVAILABLE: Couldn't read the clipboard — another app may be using it. Please try again.
error.CLIPBOARD_EMPTY: There's nothing to capture on the clipboard. Copy something first.
error.TAG_NAME_TAKEN: A tag with that name already exists. To combine the two, use “Merge into…”.
error.WORKFLOW_INVALID: There's a problem with this workflow's definition. Fix it as indicated, then save again.
error.WORKFLOW_READ_ONLY: Built-in workflows can't be edited directly. Duplicate it first, then edit the copy.
error.EXPORT_FAILED: Export failed. Check the disk space and the folder's write permission, then try again.
error.SYSTEM_SETTING_FAILED: The system didn't allow this change. Try again later, or adjust it in system settings.
error.WORKFLOW_RUN_FAILED: Couldn't re-run: this item's source doesn't support it, or the rule itself failed.
error.UPDATE_FAILED: Couldn’t check for or install the update. Your current version is unchanged — try again later.

projects.label: Projects and tags
projects.noTags: Tags you add to items will show up here.

empty.title: This project is empty
empty.hint: Open any item and choose this project in its details — it will appear here.
empty.noneHint: Projects keep related to-dos and notes together. Create one, then file items into it.

search.label: Search
search.hint: Type keywords to search titles, content and sources.
search.keys: ↑↓ select   ↵ open   ⇧↵ copy title   Esc close
search.notificationsPaused: Notifications paused; reminders that come due are summarised when you resume
search.windowHint: Type keywords to search titles, content and sources. Enter opens it in the main window.

trash.label: Trash
trash.emptyHint: Deleted items are kept here for 30 days and can be restored any time.
trash.deleted: Deleted “{{title}}” — you can get it back from the trash
trash.deletedMany: Deleted {{count}} items — you can get them back from the trash

autostart.label: Launch at startup
autostart.hint: Nivlo stays at the edge of your screen after startup, ready to catch ideas and to-dos.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Match the system, or fix it to light / dark.

hideCompleted.label: Hide completed to-dos
hideCompleted.hint: Hide to-dos you finished today from the Today list and the floating panel.

alwaysOnTop.label: Keep badge on top
alwaysOnTop.hint: When on, the floating badge always stays above other windows.

shortcut.label: Quick Create shortcut
shortcut.hint: Press it in any app to jot down a to-do right away.

later.label: Which day is “Later”
later.hint: The “Later” buttons on the badge and in the Inbox schedule items for this day.

weekStart.label: Week starts on
weekStart.hint: Affects the calendar's week and month views.

pauseNotifications.label: Pause notifications
pauseNotifications.hint: No reminders pop up while paused; due reminders aren't lost — you'll get a summary when you resume. The tray menu has this switch too.

onboarding.label: Getting started
onboarding.hint: See the basics of Nivlo again.

diagnostics.label: Export diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: Bundles the runtime environment and recent logs (with content and tokens removed) into one archive to attach when reporting a problem. Your notes, to-dos, clipboard and files are not included.

exportData.label: Export notes and to-dos
exportData.hint: Exports plain files any editor can open, including source information. Items in the trash are not exported.

backup.label: Backup
backup.hint: Bundles all your data (including workflows and settings) and pasted images into one archive. Your original files and any secrets are not included.

restore.label: Restore from backup
restore.hint: Choose a backup archive. Your current data is backed up automatically first; the restore takes effect after a restart, and the replaced data stays in the data folder.
restore.readyBody: Backup created {{created}} (Nivlo {{version}}). After restarting, this data replaces the current data; your current data was backed up to: {{safety}}

accent.label: Accent color
accent.hint: Colors the badge dot, buttons and highlights.

surface.label: Surface
surface.hint: Glass is softly translucent; Solid is fully opaque.

opacity.label: Window opacity
opacity.hint: Lower it to let what is behind show through.

skin.label: Custom skin
skin.hint: Pick several images or pixel art; they play as frames on the collapsed badge. Up to 16 frames, shrunk to fit. A GIF contributes its first frame.
skin.tooMany: Only the first {{max}} frames were kept.
skin.saveFailed: Could not save the skin. Try fewer or smaller images.
skin.readFailed: Could not read one of those images.

motion.label: Extra motion
motion.hint: Gentle movement layered on the image.

pixel.label: Pixel art mode
pixel.hint: Keeps hard pixel edges instead of smoothing. Turn it on before adding images.

showCount.label: Show count
showCount.hint: Keep the number of remaining to-dos next to the skin.

integrations.disconnected: Disconnected. The token was removed from this computer’s credential store.

help.github: Needs a token with read access to the repositories you capture links from. It is saved in the system credential store and can’t be read back.
help.jira: Jira Cloud: your account email plus an API token. Self-hosted Jira: a personal access token. Saved in the system credential store and can’t be read back.

result.authFailed: Authentication failed: the token is invalid or has expired. Reconnect with a new token.
result.permissionDenied: The token is valid but doesn’t have enough permission. {{message}}

update.label: Updates
update.hint: Updates are signed. Your data is backed up automatically before an update is installed.
update.error: Couldn’t update. Your current version is unchanged.

searchShortcut.label: Global search shortcut
searchShortcut.hint: Press it in any app to pop up search and jump straight to a to-do, note or tip.

searchPrewarm.label: Prepare global search in advance
searchPrewarm.hint: Creates the search box in the background after start-up so the first press of the shortcut opens it faster (about 0.3 s → 0.12 s), at the cost of roughly 90 MB of extra memory.

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.unscheduledHint: Drag a to-do onto a day to schedule it.

step0.title: Welcome to Nivlo
step0.body: Nivlo is a task entry point that lives at the edge of your screen: catch whatever comes to mind now, organize it later. That round badge with a number is Nivlo.

step1.title: Hover to see today, click to add
step1.body: Move the mouse onto the badge and today's tasks unfold. Click “+ To-do”, write one down and press Enter. Tick to complete, drag to reorder, or postpone to tomorrow in one click.

step2.title: Capture on the go
step2.body: Drag web links, selected text, images or files onto the badge, or copy and click “Paste”. Everything lands in the Inbox first, so you can sort it when you have time.

step3.title: Schedule in plain language
step3.body: Write “tomorrow 3pm review the plan” and Nivlo recognizes the date and time, letting you confirm before adding. In any app, press the shortcut to jot something down right away:
step3.search: To find something you saved, press this in any app:
step3.taken: {{shortcut}} is currently taken by another program, so it won’t respond. You can pick another one at the bottom left of the main window.
step3.searchTaken: The global search shortcut {{shortcut}} is taken by another program. Pick another one at the bottom left of the main window to search what you saved from any app.

scriptApi.input: Input fields, such as input.title, input.url, input.text.
scriptApi.trim: Converts to a string and trims surrounding whitespace.
scriptApi.httpGet: GET request; only hosts declared under “Script hosts” are reachable. Other hosts fail with PermissionDenied.
scriptApi.log: Writes to the dry-run log (not to run records).

workflows.label: Automation
workflows.intro: Captured content goes to the first matching rule: the higher priority number matches first, and the more specific rule wins a tie. Built-in rules are read-only — duplicate one to customize it.
workflows.groupEmpty: None yet. Pick a built-in rule and click “Duplicate” to start customizing.
workflows.pickTitle: Pick a rule to view or edit
workflows.pickHint: Or click “New rule” at the top right. A dry run shows what would be created without writing any data.
workflows.readOnlyNotice: Built-in rules can't be edited directly. Click “Duplicate” to get a copy; the copy has a higher priority, so it takes effect before the original.
workflows.duplicated: Duplicated as “{{name}}” — you can edit it now
workflows.formUnavailable: This definition uses something the form can't represent yet. Please edit it as JSON.

dryRun.label: Dry run
dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.hint: Enter a sample to see what this rule would create. Nothing is created and no run record is kept.
dryRun.nothing: This rule produced nothing (a real capture would be saved the default way).
dryRun.failed: Run failed: {{reason}} (a real capture would be saved the default way, nothing is lost)

runs.emptyHint: After you capture something that matches a rule, a record appears here (a summary only — never the full content).
runs.fellBack: The rule failed and the capture was saved the default way: {{reason}}

script.needsConfirmation: This automation contains a script. It will only run after you confirm what it can access: {{hosts}}.
script.invalidJson: Fix the JSON first — the script editor needs a valid definition.
script.none: This automation has no script yet. A script can reshape the captured input into the item to create.
script.hostsHint: Comma-separated, e.g. api.example.com. Leave empty for a script that never touches the network.

import.title: Import automation
import.intro: Review what this file does and what it asks for before importing it.
import.name: Name
import.scriptYes: Contains a script that may call: {{hosts}}
import.renamed: The id {{from}} is already taken, so it will be imported as {{to}}. Nothing existing is overwritten.
import.disabledNotice: Imported automations start disabled. Enable them after you have looked them over; scripts that use the network also ask for confirmation before they run.
import.agree: I have reviewed these permissions and want to import this automation
